_comment: EMA(200) warmup depth must match the TradingView chart history used for this export. The TV export's series origin is 2025-03-31 00:00 UTC: with ta.ema seeded as TradingView seeds it at a series origin (na until 200 bars, then the SMA of the first 200 closes), the engine reproduces every trade of the export when the feed starts at that origin.
